descriptors.label: Wi-SUN - SoC Border Router CLI with Wi-Fi connectivity
descriptors.description: The Wi-SUN Border Router CLI (Command-Line Interface) sample application allows developers to easily evaluate the Wi-SUN stack APIs. The Wi-SUN command line interface provides a serial interface to a number of the Wi-SUN stack functions. For example, it can be used to create a Wi-SUN network and then to connect and exchange IP packets with Wi-SUN devices.
